name: Squire Maltrake
summary: With the Torch of Retribution in hand, Kalaran Windblade sends you to Squire Maltrake for instructions.

sections.title: A Word with the Envoy
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade sends you to Squire Maltrake. The squire will explain how to use the Torch of Retribution.

faq.q: Who sends you to Squire Maltrake?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade sends you to Squire Maltrake and directs you to hear the instructions.
Squire Maltrake will explain how to use the Torch of Retribution.

faq.q: What comes before speaking to Squire Maltrake?
aliases: what quest comes before squire maltrake
faq.answer: You receive the Torch of Retribution before speaking to Squire Maltrake.
